value.title: Engine-free request path validator

acceptanceCriteria.text: The validator rejects `/a%2`, `/a%zz`, `/a%C3` (truncated UTF-8), `/a%FF`, a path containing a raw character above U+007F, `/a%2Fb`, `/a%2fb`, `/a%00`, a path containing a raw U+0000, `/./a`, `/a/..`, `/a/%2e`, `/a/%2E%2e` and `/a/.%2e/b`. [D-052] [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-2-2 SDS-AC-6] A segment equal to '.' or '..' after decoding, a malformed %XX, an encoded '/', NUL or an invalid UTF-8 byte sequence yields false.
The validator also rejects, as TinyHttpd's request-target parser does, a path containing a raw space, a raw control character U+0001..U+001F, U+007F or `#`. [D-052]
The validator accepts `/users/42`, `/files/%252e`, `/caf%C3%A9` and `/a/.hidden`, and its result is the same whether or not a query string follows the path. [D-052; D-051]

The validator returns an accept or reject decision without returning a decoded path, and the router lookup API has no result variant for a rejected path. [loop W residual; wave decision: path validation before lookup]

value.requirement: The system shall provide an engine-free path validator, run before the router lookup by the wave 3 dispatcher and every adapter, that inspects the raw request path without decoding it and rejects malformed percent-encoding, percent-encoded bytes that are not valid UTF-8, raw non-ASCII characters, an encoded `/`, an encoded or raw `NUL`, and any `.` or `..` segment in raw or percent-encoded form, matching the rules TinyHttpd's parser applies.
value.rationale: Covers D-052 and the wave decision on path validation before lookup (W2-003, W2-004), plus the loop W residual (the validator inspects the raw path and does not decode it). Mapping a rejection to `400` is the wave 3 dispatcher's job; the router lookup returns only the six results of D-390.
